summary: Added strict-mode control to Table.transform/transform_sql and the transform CLI command. db.py: new strict=None kwarg on both methods; transform_sql raises TransformError when strict=True without support and passes strict=self.strict if strict is None else strict to create_table_sql; transform forwards strict and stores it in self._defaults["strict"] on success. cli.py: added --strict/--no-strict option above --sql, strict param after drop_foreign_keys, passed through to both transform_sql (--sql path) and transform. Documented the feature in docs/python-api.rst (new 'Changing strict mode' section) and docs/cli.rst option list. Acceptance command passed: 270 passed, 3 skipped.
concerns: Confirm the IntegrityError on invalid data leaves no leftover temp table (existing atomic() transaction handles it; test covers it).
transform stores _defaults["strict"] only after success, as the task required for later create(replace=True).
